name: Octahedral Normal Encoding
definition: Packs a 3D normal vector into a single u8 representing one of 6 octahedral directions based on the dominant axis and sign.
summary: Octahedral Normal Encoding compresses a 3D unit normal vector into a single 8-bit integer by mapping it to one of six discrete octahedral directions, offering extreme speed and minimal memory at the cost of low accuracy.
